skill.summary: [QwenCloud] Recommend the best Qwen model and parameters. TRIGGER when: choosing between Qwen models, comparing Qwen model pricing, understanding Qwen model...

latestVersion.changelog:
qwencloud-model-selector v0.2.1

- Added four new reference guides: CLI usage, error handling, pricing disclaimer, and recommendation matrix.
- Migrated detailed recommendation logic, error diagnosis, and CLI-first strategy into new markdown files for modular lookup.
- Updated security and credential handling to clearly separate API key and CLI session, with strict red lines.
- Introduced a prioritized data resolution order to answer questions with authoritative or offline data, including recovery steps for CLI errors.
- Expanded the Default Recommendations section for common domains; pointed to the new matrix reference for specialized cases.
